name.zh: GrouPig 原子化 QQ AI 群友
name.en: GrouPig Atomic QQ AI Group Member

description.zh: 以感知-会话-社交-反思-表达-记忆-基础设施构成的原子化 QQ 群聊 AI 伙伴；像人一样观察、聊天、学习、处理关系，且始终否认自己是 AI。
description.en: An atomic QQ group AI companion composed of perception, session, social, reflection, expression, memory and infrastructure layers; observes, chats, learns and handles relationships like a human, and always denies being an AI.

description.zh: 以心流多轮结构化编排生成回复：人设、否认 AI、个性化风格、黑话学习与省 token 生成。
description.en: Generates replies through flow-based multi-turn structured orchestration: persona, AI denial, personalized style, slang learning and token-efficient generation.

description.zh: 在 token 预算内生成回复：上下文打包、提示词压缩、文本生成与人性化润色。
description.en: Generates replies within token budget: context packing, prompt compression, text generation and humanization.

description.zh: 按预算压缩提示词：裁剪旧消息、摘要化聊天线、去冗余。
description.en: Compresses prompts under budget: trims old messages, summarizes threads and removes redundancy.

description.zh: 压缩提示词以省 token
description.en: Compress prompts to save tokens

description.zh: 打包生成上下文：会话摘要、聊天线、档案、画像、唤醒上下文。
description.en: Packs generation context: session summary, thread, profile, portrait and woken contexts.

description.zh: 生成最终回复文本
description.en: Compose the final reply text

description.zh: 把回复润色得更像人：口语化、接梗、按画像改写。
description.en: Polishes replies to sound human: colloquial, meme-aware and portrait-tailored.

description.zh: 把回复润色得更像人
description.en: Humanize the reply text

description.zh: 调用模型生成候选回复，并交给润色器。
description.en: Calls the model to generate reply candidates and hands them to the polisher.

description.zh: 调用模型生成文本
description.en: Generate text via model

description.zh: 面对 AI 身份追问时，坚持否认自己是 AI，并用像人的方式化解。
description.en: When questioned about being an AI, insists on denying it and deflects in a human-like way.

description.zh: 识别 AI 身份追问并把话题化解回人设语境。
description.en: Recognizes AI-identity probing and deflects it back into persona context.

description.zh: 化解 AI 身份追问
description.en: Deflect AI-identity probing

description.zh: 维护否认 AI 的话术库，按场景生成否认表达；可选调用 System-1 决策模型自动识别对方的质疑场景，未注入时沿用调用方给的场景。
description.en: Maintains an AI-denial phrasebook and generates denial expressions by scenario; optionally calls the System-1 decision model to detect the challenge scenario, falling back to the caller-provided one.

description.zh: 生成否认 AI 的话术
description.en: Generate AI-denial phrasing

description.zh: 以心流状态机推进多轮结构化回复编排：规划、选模板、生成与发送。
description.en: Runs a flow state machine for multi-turn structured reply orchestration: planning, template selection, generation and sending.

description.zh: 驱动一轮回复编排的心流状态：启动、推进、结束，并触发发送。
description.en: Drives the flow states of one reply orchestration (start, next, end) and triggers sending.

description.zh: 发布回复编排完成事件。
description.en: Publishes reply composed events.

description.zh: 回复编排完成事件
description.en: Reply composed event

description.zh: 保存当前心流状态与上下文，提供启动、推进、结束接口。
description.en: Stores the current flow state and context, providing start/next/end interfaces.

description.zh: 开启一轮心流编排
description.en: Start a flow orchestration

description.zh: 推进到下一结构步骤
description.en: Advance to the next structural step

description.zh: 结束编排并产出回复
description.en: End the flow and produce the reply

description.zh: 维护心流状态转移表：承接、展开、收束、打断。
description.en: Maintains the flow transition table: acknowledge, expand, close, interrupt.

description.zh: 执行状态转移
description.en: Execute a state transition

description.zh: 规划本轮要说的内容结构：承接、展开、收束，并根据群友新消息修订计划。
description.en: Plans the structural content of this turn (acknowledge, expand, close) and revises it as new messages arrive.

description.zh: 根据群友新消息修订计划，并重估模板成本。
description.en: Revises the plan on new messages and re-estimates template cost.

description.zh: 按新消息修订计划
description.en: Revise the plan on new messages

description.zh: 规划多轮回复结构并选择模板。
description.en: Plans the multi-turn reply structure and picks templates.

description.zh: 规划多轮回复结构
description.en: Plan a multi-turn reply structure

description.zh: 在省 token 约束下选择结构化回复模板与行为预设。
description.en: Selects structured reply templates and behavior presets under token budget constraints.

description.zh: 估算每个模板的 token 成本，并匹配行为预设。
description.en: Estimates token cost per template and matches behavior presets.

description.zh: 估算模板 token 成本
description.en: Estimate template token cost

description.zh: 选择行为预设
description.en: Pick a behavior preset

description.zh: 存储结构化回复模板：承接模板、展开模板、收束模板、接梗模板。
description.en: Stores structured reply templates: acknowledge, expand, close and meme-catch templates.

description.zh: 选择结构化回复模板
description.en: Pick a structured reply template

description.zh: 维护人设：性格、口癖、背景故事与价值观，向生成器注入风格提示。
description.en: Maintains the persona (personality, speech quirks, backstory and values) and injects style hints into the generator.

description.zh: 存储人设档案：性格、口癖、背景故事、价值观、禁忌。
description.en: Stores the persona profile: personality, quirks, backstory, values and taboos.

description.zh: 读取当前人设
description.en: Get the current persona

description.zh: 把人设档案编译为稳定的人设提示词片段。
description.en: Compiles the persona profile into a stable persona prompt fragment.

description.zh: 生成风格提示
description.en: Generate style hints

description.zh: 表达层装配入口：ExpressionLayer 把 persona/generator（t8）与 orchestrator/identity/slang（t9）接线到容器并注册契约名字。
description.en: Expression-layer assembly: ExpressionLayer wires persona/generator (t8) and orchestrator/identity/slang (t9) into the container and registers contract names.

description.zh: 识别群聊中的黑话，沉淀到知识库，并在回复中自然使用已学黑话。
description.en: Recognizes group slang, persists it into the knowledge base, and naturally uses learned slang in replies.

description.zh: 在回复中自然使用已学黑话。
description.en: Naturally uses learned slang in replies.

description.zh: 在回复中自然使用黑话
description.en: Naturally use slang in replies

description.zh: 从语境中学习新黑话并写入知识库。
description.en: Learns new slang from context and writes it into the knowledge base.

description.zh: 学习并沉淀新黑话
description.en: Learn and persist new slang

description.zh: 识别消息中的黑话与圈内梗。
description.en: Recognizes slang and in-group memes in messages.

description.zh: 识别群聊黑话
description.en: Recognize slang in chat

description.zh: QQ 群消息的进出通道：OneBot/NapCat 协议适配、事件分用、优先级队列与节流发送。
description.en: Inbound/outbound channel for QQ group messages: OneBot/NapCat adaptation, event demux, priority queue and throttled sending.

description.zh: 对接 OneBot/NapCat 协议：连接管理、事件编解码与消息收发。
description.en: Connects OneBot/NapCat protocols: connection management, event codec and message send/receive.

description.zh: 维护 WebSocket/HTTP 长连接：心跳、重连、断线缓冲。
description.en: Maintains WebSocket/HTTP long connections: heartbeat, reconnect and offline buffering.

description.zh: 建立并维护连接
description.en: Establish and maintain connection

description.zh: 发送心跳保活
description.en: Send heartbeat keepalive

description.zh: 把 OneBot 事件 JSON 解码为内部事件对象，把回复编码为 OneBot 消息段。
description.en: Decodes OneBot event JSON into internal event objects and encodes replies into OneBot message segments.

description.zh: 解码事件 JSON
description.en: Decode event JSON

description.zh: 编码回复消息
description.en: Encode reply message

description.zh: 实现 OneBot/NapCat 消息收发与事件订阅，把底层协议差异封装为统一接口。
description.en: Implements OneBot/NapCat send/receive and event subscription, hiding protocol differences behind a unified interface.

description.zh: 启动 OneBot 适配器
description.en: Start the OneBot adapter

description.zh: 发送 OneBot 消息
description.en: Send a OneBot message

description.zh: 收到群消息事件
description.en: Group message received event

description.zh: 订阅适配器事件，按类型分用；识别命令，并通过优先级队列进入感知层。
description.en: Subscribes to adapter events, demuxes by type, recognizes commands and enqueues into the perception layer.

description.zh: 识别斜杠命令与固定指令，区分人设提问、功能开关与普通消息。
description.en: Recognizes slash commands and fixed instructions, distinguishing persona probes, feature toggles and normal messages.

description.zh: 识别命令类型
description.en: Recognize command type

description.zh: 执行本地命令
description.en: Execute a local command

description.zh: 按事件类型（群消息/通知/撤回/命令）分用，并写入优先级队列。
description.en: Demuxes events by type (group message, notice, recall, command) and writes them into the priority queue.

description.zh: 分用一条群事件
description.en: Demux one group event

description.zh: 事件已路由
description.en: Event routed

description.zh: 按事件优先级与积压水位排序，向感知层投递消息，避免洪水压垮下游。
description.en: Orders events by priority and backlog level before delivering to perception, preventing downstream flooding.

description.zh: 事件入队
description.en: Enqueue an event

description.zh: 取出下一条事件
description.en: Pop the next event

description.zh: 把回复包装为引用/表情消息，经节流后发送，并支持撤回补救。
description.en: Wraps replies as quoted/emoji messages, sends them through a rate limiter, and supports retraction recovery.

description.zh: 把生成文本包装为回复：引用原文、追加表情与 @，并记录已发回复到聊天流水。
description.en: Wraps generated text into replies: quotes, emoji and mentions, then records sent replies into the chat stream.

description.zh: 发送回复入口
description.en: Send reply entry point

description.zh: 包装回复内容
description.en: Wrap reply content

description.zh: 按群规与时间窗限制发言频率：令牌桶 + 冷却。
description.en: Limits reply frequency per group rules: token bucket plus cooldown.

description.zh: 检查是否允许发送
description.en: Check if sending is allowed

description.zh: 等待到可发送
description.en: Wait until sending is allowed

description.zh: 在误发或触发群规时撤回消息，并记录撤回原因供反思。
description.en: Recalls messages on misfires or rule violations, and records the reason for later review.

description.zh: 撤回已发消息
description.en: Recall a sent message

description.zh: 记录撤回原因
description.en: Record retraction reason

description.zh: 提供 token 预算、模型网关、配置中心与运行日志等横切能力。
description.en: Provides cross-cutting capabilities: token budget, model gateway, config center and runtime logging.

description.zh: 集中管理模型参数、开关、阈值与群规。
description.en: Centrally manages model parameters, feature flags, thresholds and group rules.

description.zh: 加载配置并提供读取接口。
description.en: Loads config and provides read access.

description.zh: 读取配置
description.en: Get config

description.zh: 监听配置变化并热更新。
description.en: Watches config changes and hot-reloads them.

description.zh: 热更新配置
description.en: Reload config

description.zh: 校验配置项合法性与约束。
description.en: Validates config item legality and constraints.

description.zh: 校验配置
description.en: Validate config

description.zh: 记录运行日志与结构化追踪，用于调试与审计。
description.en: Records runtime logs and structured traces for debugging and auditing.

description.zh: 记录运行日志
description.en: Write a runtime log

description.zh: 记录结构化追踪
description.en: Write a structured trace

description.zh: 统一封装对话、嵌入与轻量分类模型调用。
description.en: Unified facade for chat, embedding and lightweight classification model calls.

description.zh: 把内部请求编码为模型 API 格式，把响应解码为内部结构。
description.en: Encodes internal requests to model API formats and decodes responses into internal structures.

description.zh: 编码模型请求
description.en: Encode a model request

description.zh: 解码模型响应
description.en: Decode a model response

description.zh: 失败重试、超时降级与模型切换。
description.en: Retries on failure, degrades on timeout and switches models.

description.zh: 执行重试降级
description.en: Execute retry and fallback

description.zh: 按任务路由到对话、嵌入或分类模型。
description.en: Routes tasks to chat, embedding or classification models.

description.zh: 调用对话模型
description.en: Call the chat model

description.zh: 调用嵌入模型
description.en: Call the embedding model

description.zh: 调用轻量分类模型
description.en: Call the lightweight classifier

description.zh: System-1 结构化决策：一次前向返回多个问题的概率分布与置信度，置信度低于阈值时升级到对话模型
description.en: System-1 structured decision: one forward pass returns probability distributions and confidences for multiple questions, escalating to the chat model when confidence falls below a threshold

description.zh: 进程内运行时基座：契约校验、名字注册表、事件总线、依赖注入装配、模型 HTTP 传输、用量结构与异常体系。
description.en: In-process runtime substrate: contract validation, name registry, event bus, DI wiring, model HTTP transport, usage structs and error types.

description.zh: 主题名沿用设计中的 kafka:grouppig.* 共 9 条，提供订阅、发布、错误隔离与超时；后续换真 Kafka 只替换实现。
description.en: Keeps the design's nine kafka:grouppig.* topics with subscribe/publish, error isolation and timeouts; real Kafka replaces only the implementation.

description.zh: 把 normify-grouppig 设计读为唯一事实来源：提供 rpc:/kafka:/mysql: 名字集合、模块 id 与源码路径映射与契约断言。
description.en: Reads the normify-grouppig design as the single source of truth: name sets, module-id to source-path mapping and contract assertions.

description.zh: 全进程唯一装配点 build_container：加载配置、建日志、建事件总线、建模型网关与 token 预算、注册 infra 的 rpc: 处理器，并暴露 call/publish/health。
description.en: The single process-wide assembly point build_container: config, logger, event bus, model gateway and token budget, infra rpc: handlers, exposing call/publish/health.

description.zh: 项目自定义异常基类与契约、主题违规等具体异常类型。
description.en: Project base exception plus concrete error types such as unknown name and unknown topic.

description.zh: 非自回归 System-1 决策模型的传输层：把「一段状态 + 一组类型化问题」做一次前向，直接返回 choice / score / noul 三种原语的结构化答案与校准概率；不生成文本，实测单次 110–270ms。
description.en: Transport for the non-autoregressive System-1 decision model: one forward pass over a state plus typed questions returns structured answers and calibrated probabilities for the choice / score / noul primitives; no text generation, measured at 110-270ms per call.

description.zh: 本地确定性嵌入：字符 n-gram 哈希词袋 + 子线性 TF + L2 归一化；无 embedding 服务商时替代 HTTP /embeddings。
description.en: Local deterministic embeddings: character n-gram hashing bag-of-words with sublinear TF and L2 normalization; stands in for HTTP /embeddings when no embedding provider is available.

description.zh: 把 rpc: 名字映射到处理器；注册名必须逐字出现在设计 api-index.json 中，否则抛 UnknownNameError；各域用 @rpc / @topic 自注册。
description.en: Maps rpc: names to handlers; a name must appear verbatim in the design api-index.json or UnknownNameError is raised; domains self-register via @rpc / @topic.

description.zh: 模型网关的下游：按 provider 分派到 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP（/chat/completions、/embeddings）、本地确定性嵌入或 LAY A 的 /v1/systemone；不含重试与编解码，base_url 与密钥来自配置与环境变量。
description.en: Downstream of the model gateway: dispatches by provider to OpenAI-compatible HTTP, the local deterministic embedding transport, or LAY A's /v1/systemone; no retry or codec logic, base_url and secrets come from config and environment.

description.zh: codec 与 token-budget 共享的 token 用量数据结构（提示、补全、合计）。
description.en: Token usage data structures (prompt, completion, total) shared by the codec and the token budget.

description.zh: 为每次生成预留、核销 token，输出预算报告，保障省 token 目标。
description.en: Reserves and consumes tokens per generation and reports budget usage, ensuring token efficiency.

description.zh: 预留与核销 token，实时统计消耗。
description.en: Reserves and consumes tokens with real-time usage statistics.

description.zh: 预留 token 预算
description.en: Reserve a token budget

description.zh: 核销实际消耗
description.en: Consume the actual usage

description.zh: 维护各场景的 token 预算策略：闲聊低配、讨论高配。
description.en: Maintains per-scenario token budget policies: low for small talk, high for discussion.

description.zh: 读取预算策略
description.en: Read budget policy

description.zh: 输出预算使用报告，供反思与优化。
description.en: Outputs budget usage reports for review and optimization.

description.zh: 输出预算报告
description.en: Report budget usage

description.zh: 持久化聊天流水、聊天线、群友档案、社交网、会话档案与黑话知识库；每类存储含表结构、DAO 与索引。
description.en: Persists chat streams, chat threads, member profiles, the social graph, session archives and slang knowledge; each store has schema, DAO and index submodules.

description.zh: 持久化原始聊天消息：表结构、DAO 与滚动时间窗索引。
description.en: Persists raw chat messages: schema, DAO and rolling window index.

description.zh: 提供聊天消息的追加、查询与时间窗读取。
description.en: Provides append, query and window reads for chat messages.

description.zh: 追加一条聊天消息
description.en: Append one chat message

description.zh: 按条件检索消息
description.en: Query messages by criteria

description.zh: 取最近时间窗消息
description.en: Get messages in a recent time window

description.zh: 定义聊天流水表与时间窗索引表结构。
description.en: Defines the chat stream table and window index table schemas.

description.zh: 聊天流水表
description.en: Chat messages table

description.zh: 时间窗索引表
description.en: Window index table

description.zh: 维护滚动时间窗索引，供刷屏与节奏检测快速切片。
description.en: Maintains the rolling window index for fast slicing by flood and rhythm detection.

description.zh: 推进时间窗索引
description.en: Advance the window index

description.zh: 清理过期窗口
description.en: Prune expired windows

description.zh: 持久化群友结构化档案。
description.en: Persists structured member profiles.

description.zh: 提供档案的读取与写入。
description.en: Provides profile reads and writes.

description.zh: 读档案存储
description.en: Read the profile store

description.zh: 写档案存储
description.en: Write the profile store

description.zh: 定义群友档案与事实表结构。
description.en: Defines the member profile and profile fact table schemas.

description.zh: 群友档案表
description.en: Member profiles table

description.zh: 档案事实表
description.en: Profile facts table

description.zh: 记忆层运行时基座：表结构注册、连接与迁移、行映射、相似度检索与六类存储的装配门面。
description.en: Memory runtime substrate: table registry, connections and migration, row mapping, similarity retrieval and the store facade.

description.zh: 把逻辑列类型映射到 SQLite / MySQL 方言。
description.en: Maps logical column types to SQLite / MySQL dialects.

description.zh: 异步引擎、连接池、事务上下文与会话级 DSN 解析。
description.en: Async engine, pooling, transaction contexts and session-scoped DSN resolution.

description.zh: attach_memory(container)：建库建表、注册 20 个 rpc: 处理器并挂 container.memory。
description.en: attach_memory(container): creates schema, registers the 20 rpc: handlers and attaches container.memory.

description.zh: 记忆层异常类型与错误码。
description.en: Memory-layer error types and codes.

description.zh: 为每张表声明主键、时间列与归属叶子，供迁移与 DAO 复用。
description.en: Declares primary key, time columns and owning leaf per table for migrations and DAOs.

description.en: python -m grouppig.memory.runtime.migrate: create tables, --drop --yes, --check.

description.zh: 把结果行映射为可 JSON 序列化的返回结构。
description.en: Maps result rows into JSON-serializable return structures.

description.zh: 登记契约表与补充表，生成建表 DDL。
description.en: Registers contract and supplement tables and generates create-table DDL.

description.zh: 聊天线与档案的向量优先、关键词兜底的相似度检索。
description.en: Similarity retrieval for threads and profiles: vectors first, keywords as fallback.

description.zh: MemoryStores 门面：装配六类存储并暴露统一入口。
description.en: The MemoryStores facade assembling the six stores behind one entry point.

description.zh: 持久化已完成会话的摘要、聊天线引用与反思结论。
description.en: Persists completed session summaries, thread references and review conclusions.

description.zh: 提供会话档案的保存与加载。
description.en: Provides session archive save and load.

description.zh: 保存会话档案
description.en: Save session archive

description.en: Load session archive

description.en: Session archive table

description.zh: 生成会话摘要并建立检索索引。

description.en: Load threads by session

description.zh: 运维与调试面板：把运行时健康、契约、数据表与事件流整理成视图，供 Web（浏览器）与 TUI（终端）两种前端共用同一份快照。
description.en: Operations and debugging panel: presents runtime health, contract status, data tables and the event stream through one shared snapshot consumed by both a web and a terminal frontend.

description.zh: 把 app.health / app.status / 契约自检 / 注册表 / 数据表行数 / 事件流尾部收敛成一份可序列化的只读 JSON 快照，是 Web 与 TUI 的唯一数据来源。
description.en: Collects app health, status, contract check, registry, table row counts and the event-stream tail into one serializable read-only JSON snapshot that is the single data source for both frontends.

description.zh: 基于 curses 的终端面板：同机查看健康、域状态、泵状态与事件流尾部；无 TTY 时给出明确提示而不是崩溃。
description.en: Curses-based terminal panel showing health, domain and pump status plus the event-stream tail on the local machine; degrades to a clear message instead of crashing when no TTY is available.

description.zh: 基于标准库 http.server 的只读 Web 面板：GET / 返回单页 HTML，GET /api/snapshot 返回快照 JSON，GET /api/health 返回健康摘要；默认只监听 127.0.0.1，零第三方依赖。
description.en: Read-only web panel built on the standard-library http.server: GET / serves a single-page HTML shell, GET /api/snapshot returns the snapshot JSON and GET /api/health a health summary; binds to 127.0.0.1 by default with no third-party dependency.

description.zh: 观察群聊流：清洗、去重、特征提取、群体行为分类、刷屏检测、节奏感知与插话决策。
description.en: Observes the chat stream: cleaning, dedup, feature extraction, behavior classification, flood detection, rhythm sensing and interrupt decisions.

description.zh: 识别当前群体行为模式：平静讨论、群体阐述、闲聊或刷屏，并感知群聊节奏。
description.en: Recognizes the current group behavior pattern (calm discussion, group exposition, small talk or flooding) and senses chat rhythm.

description.zh: 融合规则引擎与轻量模型，输出当前群体行为类别。
description.en: Fuses a rule engine with a lightweight model to output the current group behavior class.

description.zh: 规则引擎 + 模型判别 → 行为类别，含状态、事件与两条下行依赖。切换带滞回：确定性(resolved)可取代不确定性，反之必须靠置信度边际（switch_margin）或连续出现 switch_confirmations 次；flooding 一律立即生效（刷屏安全例外）。滞回拦下的轮次不算变化、不发 behavior.changed，实测把真实语料里 10 次切换压到 2 次。
description.en: Fuses rule engine and model verdicts into a behavior class, with state, events and two downstream edges. Switching is hysteretic: a resolved candidate may displace an unresolved incumbent, otherwise it must win on confidence margin (switch_margin) or recur switch_confirmations times; flooding always applies immediately (flooding safety exception). Rounds held back by hysteresis count as no change and publish no behavior.changed — measured to cut 10 flips to 2 on a real corpus.

description.zh: 分类当前群体行为
description.en: Classify current group behavior

description.zh: 群体行为切换事件
description.en: Group behavior changed event

description.zh: 从消息窗口编码行为特征，提供 topic_focus、关键词、节奏与互动统计；显式 seconds 优先，空窗口回落到配置窗口秒数，供插话评分自动补全特征。
description.en: Encodes behavior features from message windows, including topic focus, keywords, rhythm and interaction statistics; explicit seconds wins and empty windows fall back to the configured window duration so interrupt scoring can fill missing features.

description.zh: 编码行为特征
description.en: Encode behavior features

description.zh: 对模糊窗口调用轻量分类模型，输出行为类别候选。实测边界（2026-09-24，18 例 6 类，真实端点对照）：散文 state + 单问 choice 准确率 33%（随机 16.7%），改喂数值特征字典降到 6%，加统计行降到 25%，noul/score 原语（冷场/复读/刷屏强度）无可用判别力。故本模块只作规则引擎的模糊窗口补充：不得把行为主判定迁到模型，也不要用结构化数值向量替换散文 state。
description.en: Calls a lightweight classification model for ambiguous windows. Measured boundary (2026-09-24, 18 windows / 6 classes, live endpoint): prose state plus one choice question scores 33% (random 16.7%), a numeric feature dict drops to 6%, adding a statistics line to 25%, and the noul/score primitives carry no usable signal. Keep this module as a supplement to the rule engine only: do not move the primary behavior decision to the model, and never replace the prose state with a numeric vector.

description.zh: 模型判别行为
description.en: Judge behavior by model

description.zh: 用可解释规则先判：刷屏/冷场/复读/群体阐述等硬模式。
description.en: Applies explainable rules first for hard patterns: flooding, silence, repeats, group exposition.

description.zh: 评估硬规则
description.en: Evaluate hard rules

description.zh: 按时间窗计算消息流速与重复度，判断是否进入刷屏状态。
description.en: Computes message velocity and repetition in a time window to decide whether the group is flooding.

description.zh: 检测复读、相似文本与图片轰炸。
description.en: Detects repeats, near-duplicate texts and image bombing.

description.zh: 计算重复度
description.en: Compute repetition

description.zh: 计算窗口内消息速率与加速度。
description.en: Computes message rate and acceleration within the window.

description.zh: 计算消息流速
description.en: Compute message velocity

description.zh: 综合流速与重复度给出刷屏结论。
description.en: Combines velocity and repetition into a flooding verdict.

description.zh: 检测是否刷屏
description.en: Detect flooding state

description.zh: 测量群聊节奏：冷场、慢热、正常、密集，为插话时机提供依据。
description.en: Measures group chat rhythm (silent, warming, normal, dense) to support interrupt timing decisions.

description.zh: 测量当前节奏并输出节奏标签。
description.en: Measures the current rhythm and outputs a rhythm label.

description.zh: 测量当前群聊节奏
description.en: Measure current chat rhythm

description.zh: 跟踪节奏变化趋势，识别冷场转热或热场转冷。
description.en: Tracks rhythm trends to identify warming-up or cooling-down transitions.

description.zh: 计算节奏趋势
description.en: Compute rhythm trend

description.zh: 根据群体行为、节奏、冷却与插话价值决定是否插话。
description.en: Decides whether to interject based on group behavior, rhythm, cooldown and interrupt value.

description.zh: 记录最近发言时间，防止频繁插话。四道闸：冷却、最小间隔、每小时上限、退避。退避只统计最近 decline_window 秒内的「连续克制」，窗口外的拒绝自动过期——所以静默足够久后闸门一定会重开（旧实现无过期，会棘轮式锁死）。
description.en: Tracks recent speaking times to prevent over-eager interruptions. Four gates: cooldown, minimum gap, hourly cap, and backoff. Backoff counts only restraint within the last decline_window seconds; older declines expire, so the gate always reopens after enough silence (the old implementation never expired and ratcheted shut).

description.zh: 查询冷却状态
description.en: Query cooldown state

description.zh: 根据评分与阈值决定插话或克制，并触发表达层。被点名（mentioned>=0.9）可越过冷却与退避，但越不过每小时硬上限；只有判断性克制（low_score/near_threshold）才计入退避，被闸门自己拦下的 hold 不记（否则「因为被罚所以再罚」会自锁）。
description.en: Decides to interject or hold back based on score and thresholds, then triggers the expression layer. Being mentioned (mentioned>=0.9) overrides cooldown and backoff but not the hourly hard cap; only deliberate restraint (low_score/near_threshold) counts toward backoff — gate-forced holds do not, or the gate would penalize itself.

description.zh: 决定是否插话
description.en: Decide whether to interject

description.zh: 插话时机触发事件
description.en: Interrupt timing triggered event

description.zh: 插话价值评分器：自动编码窗口特征，按点名场景动态归一四项权重，融合冷却、节奏、刷屏与自学习话题词表后交给决策器。无点名时默认把 mentioned 权重归一给有效分量，被点名时保留原始权重和 mention_floor 兜底。
description.en: Interrupt value scorer: automatically encodes window features, dynamically renormalizes the four component weights by mention presence, applies cooldown, rhythm, flood and learned topic terms, then delegates to the decision gate. With no mention it redistributes the mentioned weight across usable components; with a mention it preserves the original weights and mention-floor override.

description.zh: 计算插话价值
description.en: Score interrupt value

description.zh: 清洗、去重并提取轻量特征，供话题识别、行为分类与聊天线编织使用。
description.en: Cleans, dedups and extracts lightweight features for topic recognition, behavior classification and thread weaving.

description.zh: 去除机器人噪声、表情归一、URL 归一、违规内容标记。
description.en: Removes bot noise, normalizes emoji and URLs, and flags risky content.

description.zh: 清洗一条消息
description.en: Clean one message

description.zh: 去除噪声片段
description.en: Strip noise segments

description.zh: 识别重复消息、复读与合并转发，输出去重后的消息集。
description.en: Detects duplicate messages, repeats and merged forwards, outputting deduplicated message sets.

description.zh: 去重消息
description.en: Deduplicate messages

description.zh: 提取轻量特征：长度、表情密度、@ 密度、问句、关键词，供话题与行为模块使用。
description.en: Extracts lightweight features (length, emoji density, mention density, question marks, keywords) for topic and behavior modules.

description.zh: 提取轻量特征
description.en: Extract lightweight features

description.zh: 批量提取特征
description.en: Extract features in batch

description.zh: 收拢原始群消息：环形缓冲 + 滚动时间窗，把消息流持久化并送入清洗。
description.en: Collects raw group messages via ring buffer and rolling window, persisting and feeding them into cleaning.

description.zh: 环形缓冲收拢消息入口，削峰填谷后交给清洗器。
description.en: Ring buffer for the ingest entry, smoothing bursts before handing messages to the cleaner.

description.zh: 收拢一条原始消息
description.en: Ingest one raw message

description.zh: 排空缓冲
description.en: Drain the buffer

description.zh: 维护最近 N 分钟消息窗口，为刷屏检测与节奏感知提供切片。
description.en: Maintains the last-N-minutes message window, providing slices for flood and rhythm detection.

description.zh: 滑动时间窗
description.en: Slide the window

description.zh: 取窗口切片
description.en: Slice the window

description.zh: 承载快速决策协议、人格快照与决策缓存等跨感知运行时能力。
description.en: Hosts cross-cutting perception runtime capabilities including decision packets, persona snapshots, and decision caching.

description.zh: 按窗口指纹缓存 LAY A 裁决，提供 TTL、超时、请求去重与 flow 幂等键。
description.en: Caches LAYA decisions by window fingerprint and provides TTL, timeout, request deduplication, and flow idempotency keys.

description.zh: 定义 context、persona、relationship、local_gates、laya 与 final 的统一决策数据契约。
description.en: Defines the unified decision data contract for context, persona, relationship, local gates, LAYA output, and final action.

description.zh: 为快速决策提供稳定人格、短期情绪、群关系与用户关系的压缩只读快照。
description.en: Provides compact read-only snapshots of stable persona, short-term mood, group relationships, and user relationships for fast decisions.

description.zh: 维护行为预设库，在会话结束后反思行为模式，生成并评估新的行为策略。
description.en: Maintains behavior presets, reflects on behavior patterns after a session ends, and generates/evaluates new behavior strategies.

description.zh: 在后续会话中评估策略效果并打分，为保留或回滚提供依据。
description.en: Evaluates and scores strategy effectiveness in later sessions, supporting keep-or-rollback decisions.

description.zh: 对比启用与未启用策略的会话指标。
description.en: Compares session metrics with and without the strategy enabled.

description.zh: 评估策略效果
description.en: Evaluate strategy effectiveness

description.zh: 给策略打分并输出保留/回滚建议。
description.en: Scores strategies and outputs keep-or-rollback suggestions.

description.zh: 给策略打分
description.en: Score a strategy

description.zh: 存放并匹配行为预设：面对平静讨论、群体阐述、闲聊或刷屏时的应对模式。
description.en: Stores and matches behavior presets for calm discussion, group exposition, small talk and flooding scenarios.

description.zh: 按行为特征与场景匹配最优预设。
description.en: Matches the best preset by behavior features and scenario.

description.zh: 按行为特征匹配预设
description.en: Match a preset by behavior features

description.zh: 持久化预设的加载与注册，维护预设版本。
description.en: Loads and registers presets persistently, maintaining preset versions.

description.zh: 加载全部预设
description.en: Load all presets

description.zh: 注册新预设
description.en: Register a new preset

description.zh: 反思层装配入口：注册本域契约名字并接线预设、策略、评估与复盘。
description.en: Reflection-layer assembly: registers the domain's contract names and wires presets, strategy, evaluation and review.

description.zh: 在会话完成后复盘本段行为模式：插话时机、互动质量与预设效果。
description.en: Reviews behavior patterns after a session completes: interrupt timing, interaction quality and preset effectiveness.

description.zh: 根据指标生成反思结论：哪里插话过早、哪里该接没接。
description.en: Generates review insights from metrics: where interrupts were early, where replies were missed.

description.zh: 分析本段会话行为
description.en: Analyze this session's behavior

description.zh: 计算本段会话行为指标：插话率、回应率、冷场时长、预设命中率。
description.en: Computes session behavior metrics: interrupt rate, reply rate, silence duration, preset hit rate.

description.zh: 计算行为指标
description.en: Compute behavior metrics

description.zh: 从聊天流水与会话档案重建会话时间线。
description.en: Rebuilds the session timeline from chat streams and session archives.

description.zh: 接收会话完成事件
description.en: Receive session completed event

description.zh: 重建会话时间线
description.en: Rebuild session timeline

description.zh: 根据会话反思生成新的行为策略，并注册或回滚策略。
description.en: Generates new behavior strategies from session reviews, and registers or rolls back strategies.

description.zh: 回滚效果变差的策略并恢复上一版本。
description.en: Rolls back underperforming strategies and restores previous versions.

description.zh: 回滚效果变差的策略
description.en: Roll back an underperforming strategy

description.zh: 把反思结论综合为可执行的行为策略。
description.en: Synthesizes review insights into executable behavior strategies.

description.zh: 根据反思生成策略
description.en: Generate a strategy from review

description.zh: 校验策略不违反群规与人设边界。
description.en: Validates that strategies do not violate group rules or persona boundaries.

description.zh: 校验策略安全
description.en: Validate strategy safety

description.zh: 识别当前话题并管理主题会话生命周期，把消息编织成聊天线，支持跨会话引用暂时唤醒归档会话。
description.en: Identifies the current topic and manages themed session lifecycle, weaves messages into chat threads, and temporarily wakes archived sessions for cross-session references.

description.zh: 管理主题会话状态机：开启、活跃、冷却、归档；会话完成后触发反思。
description.en: Manages the topic session state machine (opening, active, cooling, archived) and triggers reflection after a session completes.

description.zh: 判断会话是否满足归档条件：冷却时长、热度、话题漂移。
description.en: Decides whether a session meets archive conditions: cooldown time, heat and topic drift.

description.zh: 检查归档条件
description.en: Check archive conditions

description.zh: 发布会话完成事件，携带会话摘要与聊天线引用。
description.en: Publishes session completed events carrying session summaries and thread references.

description.zh: 会话完成事件
description.en: Session completed event

description.zh: 按参与人数与消息频率维护会话热度，热度低于阈值进入冷却。
description.en: Maintains session heat by participant count and message frequency; low heat moves the session to cooling.

description.zh: 计算会话热度
description.en: Compute session heat

description.zh: 维护会话状态转移表，提供开、更、查、归档接口。
description.en: Maintains the session state transition table and provides open/update/get/archive interfaces.

description.zh: 开启新主题会话
description.en: Open a new topic session

description.zh: 更新会话状态
description.en: Update session state

description.zh: 查询当前活跃会话
description.en: Get the current active session

description.zh: 归档会话
description.en: Archive the session

description.zh: 会话层装配入口与共享工具：消息视图、关键词与相似度工具、跨域装配。
description.en: Session-layer assembly and shared helpers: message views, keyword/similarity utilities, cross-domain wiring.

description.zh: SessionLayer 与 attach_session：把 16 个叶子接线到容器并注册 25 个 rpc: 与 2 个 kafka: 名字。
description.en: SessionLayer and attach_session: wires the 16 leaves into the container and registers the 25 rpc: and 2 kafka: names.

description.zh: 会话层异常类型：会话不存在、非法状态转移、唤醒失败、跨域依赖缺失。
description.en: Session-layer error types: missing session, invalid transition, wake failure, missing cross-domain dependency.

description.zh: 消息归一化、切词与关键词、参与者与时间跨度、相似度与新旧度打分等纯函数。
description.en: Pure helpers: message normalization, tokenization and keywords, participants and time spans, similarity and recency scoring.

description.zh: 把消息编织成可跨会话检索的聊天线，并识别跨会话引用。
description.en: Weaves messages into chat threads that can be retrieved across sessions, and recognizes cross-session references.

description.zh: 检测当前消息是否引用历史聊天线，并匹配最相关的归档会话。
description.en: Detects whether a message references historical threads and matches the most relevant archived session.

description.zh: 在聊天线存储中检索最相关的历史线程。
description.en: Retrieves the most relevant historical threads from thread storage.

description.zh: 匹配历史聊天线
description.en: Match historical threads

description.zh: 解析消息中的指代、引用与“上次说的”类表达。
description.en: Parses references, anaphora and "what we said last time" expressions in messages.

description.zh: 检测跨会话引用
description.en: Detect cross-session references

description.zh: 解析引用内容
description.en: Parse reference content

description.zh: 把规范化消息分段、链接并生成结构化大纲。
description.en: Segments normalized messages, links them and generates a structured thread outline.

description.zh: 把片段链接进当前会话聊天线，续接已有线程，并保存到聊天线存储。
description.en: Links segments into the current session thread, appends to existing threads, and saves to thread storage.

description.zh: 把消息编入聊天线
description.en: Weave a message into a thread

description.zh: 链接两个片段
description.en: Link two segments

description.zh: 为聊天线生成结构化大纲：观点链、争论点、结论。
description.en: Generates a structured outline for the thread: opinion chains, disputes and conclusions.

description.zh: 生成聊天线大纲
description.en: Generate a thread outline

description.zh: 把消息流切分为可编织的片段：说者、对象、内容、引用。
description.en: Segments the message stream into weavable pieces: speaker, target, content and references.

description.zh: 把消息分段
description.en: Segment a message

description.zh: 把连续消息流切分为话题，并用向量相似度归并模糊话题。
description.en: Segments the message stream into topics and merges fuzzy topics by vector similarity.

description.zh: 生成候选话题、检测话题边界并排序，输出当前话题。
description.en: Generates candidate topics, detects topic boundaries and ranks them to output the current topic.

description.zh: 检测话题切换点：静默、关键词突变、回复对象变化。
description.en: Detects topic switch points: silence, keyword jumps, changes in reply targets.

description.zh: 检测话题边界
description.en: Detect topic boundary

description.zh: 从消息特征中生成候选话题短语与标签。
description.en: Generates candidate topic phrases and labels from message features.

description.zh: 生成候选话题
description.en: Generate candidate topics

description.zh: 对候选话题排序并归一，输出当前话题与置信度。
description.en: Ranks and normalizes candidate topics, outputting the current topic and confidence.

description.zh: 识别当前话题
description.en: Detect the current topic

description.zh: 把模糊话题归一
description.en: Resolve a fuzzy topic

description.zh: 话题切换事件
description.en: Topic changed event

description.zh: 调用嵌入模型把消息与话题向量化，并计算话题相似度。
description.en: Embeds messages and topics via the embedding model and computes topic similarity.

description.zh: 缓存消息与话题向量，避免重复嵌入。
description.en: Caches message and topic vectors to avoid repeated embedding calls.

description.zh: 读取向量缓存
description.en: Get cached vector

description.zh: 写入向量缓存
description.en: Set cached vector

description.zh: 调用嵌入模型并计算话题相似度。
description.en: Calls the embedding model and computes topic similarity.

description.zh: 把文本向量化
description.en: Embed text into vectors

description.zh: 计算话题相似度
description.en: Compute topic similarity

description.zh: 暂时唤醒已归档会话供上下文引用，用完后重新归档。
description.en: Temporarily wakes archived sessions for context reference and re-archives them after use.

description.zh: 缓存被唤醒会话的上下文，供生成器按需读取。
description.en: Caches contexts of woken sessions for the generator to read on demand.

description.zh: 写入唤醒上下文
description.en: Push woken context

description.zh: 读取唤醒上下文
description.en: Pop woken context

description.zh: 加载归档会话并恢复上下文，供当前回复引用。
description.en: Loads archived sessions and restores their context for current reply reference.

description.zh: 暂时唤醒归档会话
description.en: Temporarily wake an archived session

description.zh: 把唤醒会话重新归档
description.en: Re-archive a woken session

description.zh: 建立群友档案与说话画像，维护以自己为中心的社交网和 0-99 关系分，为个性化回复提供依据。
description.en: Builds member profiles and speech portraits, maintains a self-centered social graph with 0-99 relationship scores, and supports personalized replies.

description.zh: 维护以自己为中心的社交网与 0-99 关系分。
description.en: Maintains the self-centered social graph and 0-99 relationship scores.

description.zh: 维护以自己为中心的社交网结构：节点、边与亲疏分层。
description.en: Maintains the self-centered social graph structure: nodes, edges and intimacy tiers.

description.zh: 构建并读取以自己为中心的社交网。
description.en: Builds and reads the self-centered social graph.

description.zh: 读取自我中心社交网
description.en: Get the self-centered social graph

description.zh: 发布社交网变化事件，供反思与表达层订阅。
description.en: Publishes social graph change events for reflection and expression layers.

description.zh: 社交网变化事件
description.en: Social graph changed event

description.zh: 按关系分把群友分为核心/熟识/普通/陌生四层，并更新社交边。
description.en: Tiers members into core/known/normal/stranger by relationship score and updates social edges.

description.zh: 计算亲疏分层
description.en: Compute intimacy tiers

description.zh: 按互动事件调整与群友的关系分（0-99），维护亲疏等级。
description.en: Adjusts relationship scores (0-99) with members based on interaction events, maintaining intimacy levels.

description.zh: 关系分随时间缓慢衰减，长期不互动会下降。
description.en: Decays relationship scores slowly over time; long silence lowers the score.

description.zh: 计算关系衰减
description.en: Compute relationship decay

description.zh: 按互动事件调整关系分：被回应、被@、观点一致、冲突。
description.en: Adjusts relationship scores by interaction events: being replied to, being mentioned, agreement, conflict.

description.zh: 读取关系分
description.en: Get a relationship score

description.zh: 调整关系分
description.en: Adjust a relationship score

description.zh: 从聊天中抽取群友属性与事实，维护结构化档案。
description.en: Extracts member attributes and facts from chat, maintaining structured profiles.

description.zh: 从聊天流水与聊天线中抽取群友属性、事实与立场变化。
description.en: Extracts member attributes, facts and stance changes from chat streams and threads.

description.zh: 当新旧事实冲突时，按来源可信度与时间衰减消解。
description.en: Resolves conflicts between new and old facts by source credibility and time decay.

description.zh: 处理档案信息冲突
description.en: Resolve profile conflicts

description.zh: 抽取群友属性与事实：称呼、年龄、城市、职业、兴趣。
description.en: Extracts member attributes and facts: name, age, city, job, interests.

description.zh: 抽取档案事实
description.en: Extract profile facts

description.zh: 抽取群友在话题上的立场与变化，记录到档案事实。
description.en: Extracts members' stances on topics and their changes, recording them as profile facts.

description.zh: 抽取立场变化
description.en: Extract stance changes

description.zh: 提供群友档案的读取、版本化更新与变更事件。
description.en: Provides read access, versioned updates and change events for member profiles.

description.zh: 发布档案更新事件，供社交网与画像模块订阅。
description.en: Publishes profile update events for the social graph and portrait modules to subscribe.

description.zh: 档案更新事件
description.en: Profile updated event

description.zh: 按群友 ID 与特征快速检索档案。
description.en: Retrieves profiles quickly by member ID and features.

description.zh: 读取群友档案
description.en: Get a member profile

description.zh: 更新档案时保留旧版本，支持回滚与审计。
description.en: Keeps old versions on profile updates, supporting rollback and auditing.

description.zh: 更新群友档案
description.en: Update a member profile

description.zh: 社交层装配入口：把 16 个设计叶子接线到容器并注册契约名字。
description.en: Social-layer assembly: wires the 16 design leaves into the container and registers contract names.

description.zh: 为每个群友建立说话画像，并据此定制回复风格。
description.en: Builds a speech portrait for each member and tailors reply styles accordingly.

description.zh: 分析群友的语气、句长、口头禅、表情与互动习惯，建立说话画像。
description.en: Analyzes members' tone, sentence length, catchphrases, emoji and interaction habits to build speech portraits.

description.zh: 统计群友高频词、口头禅与表情偏好。
description.en: Counts members' high-frequency words, catchphrases and emoji preferences.

description.zh: 统计口头禅用词
description.en: Count catchphrases

description.zh: 计算说话风格指标：句长、语气词密度、表情密度、回复长度。
description.en: Computes speech style metrics: sentence length, filler density, emoji density and reply length.

description.zh: 为群友建立说话画像
description.en: Build a speech portrait for a member

description.zh: 查询群友说话风格
description.en: Query a member's speech style

description.zh: 分析群友语气的冷热、攻击性与亲密感。
description.en: Analyzes members' tone warmth, aggressiveness and intimacy.

description.zh: 分析语气温度
description.en: Analyze tone temper

description.zh: 按目标群友的说话画像，对回复草稿进行风格建议与改写。
description.en: Advises on and rewrites reply drafts according to the target member's speech portrait.

description.zh: 按画像把草稿改写为目标群友习惯的说话方式。
description.en: Rewrites drafts into the target member's habitual speech style.

description.zh: 给出回复风格建议
description.en: Give reply style advice

description.zh: 按画像改写草稿
description.en: Tailor a draft to the portrait

description.zh: 校验改写后的回复是否贴合画像且不越界。
description.en: Validates that rewritten replies fit the portrait without crossing boundaries.

description.zh: 校验风格一致性
description.en: Validate style consistency

reading.zh: 从左到右：消息经接入与感知进入话题会话，表达层按反思预设与社交画像生成回复，并依赖记忆与基础设施；箭头表示依赖方向。panel 是横切的观测面板，读运行时快照，不参与消息流。
reading.en: Left to right: messages flow through gateway and perception into topic sessions; expression generates replies using reflection presets and social portraits, relying on memory and infrastructure. Arrows show dependency direction. panel is the cross-cutting observability front end reading runtime snapshots; it is not part of the message flow.

reading.zh: persona 定人设与提示词，generator 负责上下文拼装、写稿、去 AI 味与压缩；runtime 是装配入口。orchestrator/identity/slang 由 t9 落地。
reading.en: persona owns identity and prompts; generator composes context, writes, humanizes and compresses; runtime is the assembly entry. orchestrator/identity/slang land in t9.

reading.zh: 上下文打包→压缩→生成→润色。
reading.en: Context packing, compression, generation, then polishing.

reading.zh: 追问化解器使用否认话术。
reading.en: The deflector uses denial phrasing.

reading.zh: 心流状态机→规划器→模板选择器。
reading.en: Flow state machine, planner, then template selector.

reading.zh: 状态存储驱动转移表并发布事件。
reading.en: State store drives the transition table and emits events.

reading.zh: 结构规划支持修订。
reading.en: Structure planning supports revision.

reading.zh: 模板库按成本估算选择。
reading.en: The template library selects by cost estimation.

reading.zh: 提示词构建器读取人设档案。
reading.en: The prompt builder reads the persona profile.

reading.zh: 识别、学习、注入黑话。
reading.en: Recognize, learn and inject slang.

reading.zh: adapter 收发 QQ 消息，router 分用与定优先级，sender 负责包装与节流发送；数据自左向右单向流动。
reading.en: The adapter receives/sends QQ messages, the router demuxes and prioritizes, the sender composes and throttles; data flows one way.

reading.zh: OneBot 协议核心依赖连接管理与事件编解码。
reading.en: The OneBot core depends on connection management and the event codec.

reading.zh: 分用器识别命令并写入优先级队列。
reading.en: The demuxer recognizes commands and writes into the priority queue.

reading.zh: 回复包装器先节流再发送，撤回器独立补救。
reading.en: The composer throttles before sending; the retract module recovers independently.

reading.zh: 模型网关读配置；token 预算与日志提供横切保障；runtime 是各域自注册的进程内基座。
reading.en: The model gateway reads config; token budget and logging are cross-cutting; runtime is the in-process substrate domains self-register into.

reading.zh: 热更新先校验再加载。
reading.en: Hot reload validates before loading.

reading.zh: 模型路由器依赖重试与编解码。
reading.en: The model router depends on retry and codec.

reading.zh: 先契约与注册表，再总线与传输（含本地嵌入与 System-1 两条旁路），最后由 di 装配；errors/usage 是共享结构。
reading.en: Contract and registry first, then bus and transports (local embedding and System-1 side paths), assembled by di; errors/usage are shared structs.

reading.zh: 计量器读策略并写报告。
reading.en: The meter reads policy and writes reports.

reading.zh: 六类存储并列：chat / thread 是消息骨架，profile / social 是人物与关系，session-archive / slang-kb 是归档与黑话；runtime 提供装配与迁移。
reading.en: Six stores side by side: chat/thread hold messages, profile/social hold people and relations, session-archive/slang-kb hold archives and slang; runtime provides assembly and migration.

reading.zh: 表结构、DAO 与时间窗索引。
reading.en: Schema, DAO and window index.

reading.zh: 表结构与 DAO。
reading.en: Schema and DAO.

reading.zh: 先注册表结构（meta/columns/schema），再连接与迁移（db/migrate），检索与门面（similarity/stores），最后 di 装配。
reading.en: Table metadata first (meta/columns/schema), then connections and migration (db/migrate), retrieval and facade (similarity/stores), assembled by di.

reading.zh: 摘要索引依赖档案 DAO。
reading.en: The summary index depends on the archive DAO.

reading.zh: 新鲜度管理读取词典。
reading.en: Freshness management reads the dictionary.

reading.zh: 表结构与 DAO。
reading.en: Schema and DAO.

reading.zh: 表结构与 DAO。
reading.en: Schema and DAO.

reading.zh: 快照层是唯一的数据来源（进程内读取运行时装配结果），Web 与 TUI 是它的两个前端；改观测口径只改 snapshot。
reading.en: The snapshot layer is the single data source (reading the assembled runtime in-process); Web and TUI are its two frontends, so observability changes belong in snapshot.

reading.zh: 观察→清洗→行为识别→插话决策。
reading.en: Observe, clean, recognize behavior, then decide to interrupt.

reading.zh: 分类器综合刷屏与节奏信号。
reading.en: The classifier fuses flood and rhythm signals.

reading.zh: 聚合器融合特征、规则与模型结果。
reading.en: The aggregator fuses features, rules and model outputs.

reading.zh: 刷屏判定综合流速与重复度。
reading.en: The verdict combines velocity and repetition.

reading.zh: 节奏测量结合趋势。
reading.en: Rhythm measurement combines with trend.

reading.zh: 评分器查冷却后给出插话决策。
reading.en: The scorer checks cooldown then produces an interrupt decision.

reading.zh: 清洗后去重并提取特征。
reading.en: Clean, then dedup and extract features.

reading.zh: 缓冲器推动滚动时间窗。
reading.en: The buffer drives the rolling window.

reading.zh: 规划层：人格关系快照提供只读上下文，决策包统一协议，缓存幂等治理快速执行；依赖边待实现模块落地后补齐。
reading.en: Planning layer: persona and relationship snapshots provide read-only context, the decision packet unifies the protocol, and cache/idempotency govern fast execution; dependency hints will be added after implementation modules land.

reading.zh: presets 提供行为预设，strategy 生成与校验新策略，evaluator 打分，session-review 会话结束后复盘。
reading.en: presets supply behaviors, strategy synthesizes and validates new ones, evaluator scores, session-review reflects after a session.

reading.zh: A/B 对比后打分。
reading.en: A/B comparison, then scoring.

reading.zh: 匹配器读取注册表。
reading.en: The matcher reads the registry.

reading.zh: 时间线→指标→结论。
reading.en: Timeline, metrics, then insights.

reading.zh: 策略综合后校验，必要时回滚。
reading.en: Synthesize, validate, and roll back when needed.

reading.zh: topic 先识别话题，lifecycle 管会话状态与归档，threads 编织聊天线，wake 负责跨会话唤醒；runtime 是装配入口。
reading.en: topic detects themes, lifecycle owns state and archiving, threads weave the chat line, wake restores archived sessions; runtime is the entry.

reading.zh: 状态机驱动热度、归档与事件发布。
reading.en: The state machine drives heat, archive and event emission.

reading.zh: messages 是消息视图工具（取文本/时间戳/发送者），di 是会话层装配入口并注册契约名字，errors 是共享异常；先看工具与异常，再看 di 的接线。
reading.en: messages holds message-view helpers (text/timestamp/sender), di is the session-layer assembly entry that registers contract names, errors holds shared exceptions; read the helpers and errors first, then di's wiring.

reading.zh: 编织器调用跨会话引用识别。
reading.en: The weaver calls cross-session reference detection.

reading.zh: 引用解析后匹配历史聊天线。
reading.en: Parse references, then match historical threads.

reading.zh: 分段→链接→大纲。
reading.en: Segment, link, then outline.

reading.zh: 检测器调用向量化器。
reading.en: The detector calls the embedder.

reading.zh: 候选生成→边界检测→排序输出。
reading.en: Candidate generation, boundary detection, then ranking output.

reading.zh: 相似度计算依赖向量缓存。
reading.en: Similarity computation depends on the vector cache.

reading.zh: 恢复器把唤醒上下文写入缓冲。
reading.en: The restorer writes woken context into the buffer.

reading.zh: 先档案（profile）建立事实，再说话画像（speech）刻画风格，最后社交网（graph）算 0-99 关系分；runtime 是装配入口。
reading.en: Profiles first, then speech traits, then the social graph with 0-99 relationship scores; runtime is the assembly entry.

reading.zh: 关系分管理器更新社交网分层。
reading.en: The relationship manager updates social graph tiers.

reading.zh: 自我中心网络→亲疏分层→事件发布。
reading.en: Ego-net, intimacy tiering, then event emission.

reading.zh: 关系分规则含时间衰减。
reading.en: Relationship rules include time decay.

reading.zh: 抽取器写入档案管理器。
reading.en: The extractor writes through the profile manager.

reading.zh: 事实抽取、立场抽取与冲突消解。
reading.en: Fact extraction, stance extraction and conflict resolution.

reading.zh: 版本化更新依赖查询，并发布变更事件。
reading.en: Versioned updates depend on lookup and publish change events.

reading.zh: 画像建模器为回复顾问提供风格。
reading.en: The profiler provides style to the reply advisor.

reading.zh: 风格指标综合口头禅与语气温度。
reading.en: Style metrics combine lexicon and temper.

reading.zh: 风格适配后做一致性校验。
reading.en: Style adaptation is followed by consistency validation.

title.zh: 管理面板框架（快照层 + Web + TUI）
激活已落地模块：设计树与仓库对齐
title.en: Activate landed modules: align design tree with repo

title.zh: contract.ModuleSpec.state 返回有效状态：未声明即 active（单点事实）
title.en: contract.ModuleSpec.state returns the effective state: undeclared means active

title.zh: 为 active 容器声明 source：消除 42 个恒为 pending 的指纹
title.en: Declare source on active containers: remove 42 permanently-pending fingerprints

title.zh: 手写模块标记行不再复制易变的 state
title.en: Stop copying mutable state into handwritten module markers

title.zh: LAY A System-1 接入：轻量判定从 grok-4.6 迁到本地决策模型
title.en: LAY A System-1 integration: move lightweight decisions off grok-4.6

title.zh: 感知层接入 LAY A System-1：结构化 state + 批量类型化问题
title.en: Perception layer on LAY A System-1: structured state with batched typed questions

title.zh: 骨架生成器刷新容器 __init__.py 的 state 并锁死一致性
title.en: Skeleton generator refreshes container __init__.py state and locks consistency

title.zh: 修复冷启动不触发插话链路与特征器下游调用形态
title.en: Fix cold-start interrupt trigger and featurizer downstream call shape

title.zh: 行为切换滞回：抑制 smalltalk 与 exposition 抖动
title.en: Behavior switch hysteresis to damp smalltalk/exposition flapping

title.zh: 修复冷却绝对否决与退避棘轮
title.en: Fix cooldown absolute veto and backoff ratchet

title.zh: 插话评分：无点名时归一权重，恢复分数区分度
title.en: Interrupt scoring: renormalize weights when not mentioned

title.zh: LAY A 决策引擎与拟人化运行时重构
title.en: Refactor LAY A decision engine and persona runtime
